title: Real-Time FinTech Event Sourcing & CQRS Ledger
subtitle: Sub-millisecond high-frequency ledger processing with transactional outbox, Kafka event backbone, and ClickHouse OLAP projections.

overview.summary: An immutable, audit-compliant financial ledger architecture capable of processing 120,000 transactions/sec with strict idempotency and zero data loss. Employs Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) with optimized read/write paths.
overview.problemStatement: Traditional ACID databases suffer severe write lock contention during high-frequency balance adjustments and global trading spikes, while analytics queries degrade transactional throughput.
corePrinciples: Immutable Event Journal as the absolute single source of truth
Transactional Outbox Pattern guaranteeing at-least-once message delivery without 2PC
Asynchronous Read Model Projections optimized for sub-10ms user query latencies
Deterministic State Reconstruction via event stream replay

data.label: Client Edge & Apps
data.subtitle: Mobile, Web & HFT Trading APIs
data.description: Multi-platform client surface interfacing through TLS 1.3 with client-side request signatures and idempotency tokens.
responsibilities: Generates unique UUIDv7 idempotency keys
Validates request payload schemas client-side
Maintains persistent bi-directional WebSocket channels
failureModes: Local network drops (handled with exponential backoff offline queues)

data.label: Kong API Gateway
data.subtitle: Rate Limiting & Auth Validation
data.description: High-performance Envoy-based API gateway handling token introspection, global rate-limiting, and routing between Command and Query engines.
responsibilities: JWT & mTLS authentication and scope validation
Sliding-window distributed token-bucket rate limiting
Splits mutating Commands from read Queries
failureModes: Rate limiter outage (fails open to local memory fallback token bucket)

data.label: Order & Ledger Service
data.subtitle: Command Handler (Go + gRPC)
data.description: Validates business invariants (e.g. account balance, margin checks), commits event entities to Write-Store, and atomically appends outbox records.

specs.failoverStrategy: K8s Pod Disruption Budget with PreStop hooks

responsibilities: Strict domain invariant and balance boundary validation
Generates Domain Events (e.g., OrderPlaced, LedgerDebited)
Writes atomic transactions to PostgreSQL Master + Outbox Table

data.label: Transactional DB
data.subtitle: PostgreSQL 16 Primary (ACID)
data.description: High-write primary database storing normalized domain entities and the transactional outbox table with strict serializable isolation.
responsibilities: Guarantees ACID transactions for command state mutations
Maintains Outbox log table for CDC ingestion
Synchronous streaming replication to standby nodes

data.label: Debezium CDC Connector
data.subtitle: Log-based Change Data Capture
data.description: Reads PostgreSQL write-ahead log (WAL) records using pgoutput logical decoding and converts outbox rows into guaranteed Kafka event streams.
responsibilities: Extracts outbox events from Postgres WAL logs
Serializes payloads with Confluent Schema Registry Avro formats
Ensures exactly-once delivery semantics into Kafka partitions

data.label: Apache Kafka Mesh
data.subtitle: Event Backbone (KRaft Mode)
data.description: High-throughput partitioned event broker orchestrating domain events, replayable event logs, and downstream projection pipelines.
responsibilities: Partitioning events by aggregate root ID (Account/Order)
Long-term immutable event log storage via S3 tiered storage
Provides event back-pressure for asynchronous consumers

data.label: Projection Consumer Engine
data.subtitle: Stream Processors (Rust / Flink)
data.description: Consumes raw domain events, performs streaming aggregations, and writes denormalized read-models to Redis and ClickHouse.

specs.failoverStrategy: Checkpoint state recovery via RocksDB backend

responsibilities: Builds materialised balance summaries and user portfolio models
Updates low-latency Redis cache for hot accounts
Batches columnar writes to ClickHouse OLAP cluster

data.label: Redis Cluster + ClickHouse
data.subtitle: Denormalized Query Projections
data.description: Dual read tier combining memory-speed Redis key-value stores for live balances and ClickHouse for historical audit analytics.
responsibilities: Serves sub-millisecond account balance & portfolio reads
Executes complex historical ledger analytics across billions of events
Zero lock interference with write pipeline

data.label: Query & WebSocket Engine
data.subtitle: Read Model API (Node / Go)
data.description: High-concurrency read gateway streaming real-time balance updates over WebSockets and fulfilling complex GraphQL/REST queries.
responsibilities: Pushes real-time order fill updates to connected clients
Queries Redis and ClickHouse for balance & ledger views
Aggregates multi-account balance metrics

data.description: Authenticated user requests with cryptographic idempotency keys.
Fast binary gRPC routing for balance and ledger mutations.
Transactional commit appending event record and domain snapshot.
Streaming logical replication reading transaction logs asynchronously.
Publishing ordered domain events to aggregate-keyed partitions.
Continuous event consumption with consumer group checkpointing.
Denormalizing event stream into high-speed query models.
Read requests routed directly to query microservice.
Direct read query against Redis cache and ClickHouse engine.
Pushing live updated ledger states directly to client UI.

simulationFlow.title: Client Dispatches Signed Transfer Command
simulationFlow.description: User submits a fund transfer of $5,000 USD. The client signs the payload using an ECDSA key and attaches a UUIDv7 idempotency token.

simulationFlow.title: Gateway Rate Checks & Routes to Command Service
simulationFlow.description: Gateway validates the bearer JWT, asserts the rate-limit token bucket, and forwards the command over internal gRPC.

simulationFlow.title: Transactional Outbox Commit to Primary DB
simulationFlow.description: Command service checks account balance constraints and executes a single ACID transaction committing the entity mutation and appending an outbox record.

simulationFlow.title: Debezium Captures WAL and Publishes to Kafka
simulationFlow.description: Debezium streams the WAL transaction event without double-writing and emits an Avro-encoded message to the partitioned Kafka topic.

simulationFlow.title: Projection Engine Updates Redis & ClickHouse
simulationFlow.description: Rust stream workers consume the Kafka event, calculate updated balances, and populate Redis key-value cache and ClickHouse OLAP tables.

simulationFlow.title: Real-Time WebSocket Push to Client UI
simulationFlow.description: The Query service detects the projection update via Redis PubSub and instantly pushes the live balance change to the user's active screen.

pros: Eliminates silent dual-write divergence and ghost transactions
Zero performance penalty on HTTP request thread
Guarantees at-least-once message delivery to Kafka
cons: Adds Debezium / Kafka Connect operational footprint
Sub-second eventual consistency lag on read projections
rejectedAlternatives: Synchronous Dual Write in Go Service

tradeoffs.decision: Redis Cluster + ClickHouse vs Direct Read-Replicas
pros: P99 read latency drops from 45ms to 0.6ms on hot queries
Complex financial queries never lock primary transactional tables
ClickHouse supports billions of rows of historical ledger inspection
cons: Requires maintaining asynchronous projection worker code
Clients must tolerate up to 15ms eventual consistency delay
rejectedAlternatives: Postgres Read Replicas with heavy SQL JOINs

securityAndCompliance.implementation: Append-only Kafka event logs backed by WORM S3 Object Lock and cryptographic hash chain verification.
mTLS with SPIFFE/SPIRE dynamic identities between internal microservices and AES-256-GCM payloads.
UUIDv7 deterministic keys validated in Redis distributed bloom filters and Postgres unique constraints.
